reading: PSE&G, the regulated New Jersey electric and gas utility subsidiary of Public Service Enterprise Group and headquartered in Newark, is primarily an energy infrastructure provider to data centers rather than a data center operator in its own right. The company's published Data Center Solutions offering provides tailored high-voltage electrical service, at 138kV, 230kV, and 345kV depending on facility needs, to data center customers in New Jersey and PSEG's Long Island and Rockaways, New York service territory, requiring dedicated land parcels of 2.5 to 7 acres depending on voltage level to support hyperscale and cloud computing facilities that now demand 200 to 300 watts per square foot compared to 20 to 30 watts for legacy computing loads. Because PSE&G's core business is utility infrastructure rather than data center operations or colocation, this registry's New Jersey facility record under the PSE&G name most likely reflects the company's own grid or network operations infrastructure rather than a commercial data center serving outside tenants, a distinction important for accurately classifying PSE&G relative to the wholesale and colocation operators that make up most of this registry's other New Jersey facilities, such as fifteenfortyseven Critical Systems Realty and GlobeNet.
